import numpy as np, os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
i=np.array(G['Demo pair 4 input']); o=np.array(G['Demo pair 4 output'])
for r,a,b in zip(range(i.shape[0]),i,o):
    nz=a.nonzero()[0]
    lz=nz[0] if len(nz)>0 else -1; cl=max(nz) if len(nz)>0 else -1
    diff=[(c,int(a[c]),int(b[c])) for c in range(a.size) if a[c]!=b[c]]
    print(f'r{r:2} lz={lz:2} span={lz}-{cl:2} diffs:',diff, 'unchanged?', all(a==b))

import os,re,json,numpy as np
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
for n in ['Demo pair %d'%(i) for i in range(1,9)]:
    i=np.array(G[n+' input']); o=np.array(G[n+' output'])
    H,W=i.shape
    diffs=[]
    for r in range(H):
        goodp=sum(1 for p in range(1,W+1) if all(o[r,c]==o[r,c%p] for c in range(W)))
        mis=[[p,sum(i[r,c]!=o[r,c%p] for c in range(W))] for p in range(1,W+1) if goodp==1 or True][:0]  # placeholder
        ps=[(sum(i[r,c]!=o[r,c%p] for c in range(W)),p,int(i[r][0])) for p in range(1,W+1) if all(o[r,c]==o[r,c%p] for c in range(W))]
        ps.sort(key=lambda x:(x[0],-x[1]))
        diffs.append(ps[:4])
    print('===',n)
    for r,ps in enumerate(diffs):
        print(f' r{r}: inp={list(i[r])} ; best=(mis,{ps[0][0]}),p={ps[0][1]}  next={(ps[1][0],ps[1][1]) if len(ps)>1 else None}')

import os,re,json,numpy as np
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

import os,re,json,numpy as np
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
# Look at each demo's last column region pattern vs output. Let me visualize the changed cells as a picture with row/col indices per demo:
for name in ['Demo pair %d'%k for k in range(1,9)]:
    i=np.array(G[name+' input']); o=np.array(G[name+' output']); H,W=i.shape
    chm=(i!=o); rs,cz=np.where(chm)
    print('===',name,'H=',H,'W=',W,'changed:',len(rs),'positions:')
    for r,c in zip(rs,cz):
        # find leftmost fg run start and end in this row
        nz=[c2 for c2 in range(W) if i[r,c2]!=max(Counter(i.flatten()),key=lambda v:v)]
        print('  (%d,%d) val=%d ; trailing run [cols %d..%d]'%(r,c,i[r,c],min(nz),max(nz)))

import os,re,json,numpy as np
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
# Feature study: for each changed cell and each non-changed dom cell, compute features; find separating rule.
def feats(i,o):
    H,W=i.shape; dom=max(Counter(i.flatten()),key=lambda v:v)
    ch=(i!=o)
    rs,cz=np.where(ch)
    nc=[]; nn=[]
    for r,c in zip(rs,cz):
        lr=[x for x in range(W) if i[r,x]!=dom and x<c]
        rr=[x for x in range(W) if i[r,x]==dom and x>c]
        fc=int(bool(rr)); lc=len(lr); cpos=c; edge=c==W-1
        nc.append((fc,lc,cpos,int(edge)))
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if i[r,c]==dom and not ch[r,c]:
                lr=[x for x in range(W) if i[r,x]!=dom and x<c]
                rr=[x for x in range(W) if i[r,x]==dom and x>c]
                fc=int(bool(rr)); lc=len(lr); cpos=c; edge=c==W-1
                nn.append((fc,lc,cpos,int(edge)))
    return np.array(nc),np.array(nn),dom
allf=[]
for k in range(1,9):
    i=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {k} input']); o=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {k} output'])
    ch,nn,d=feats(i,o)
    allf.append((ch,nn,d,k))
    # simple tests
    print('demo',k,'W',i.shape[1],'H',i.shape[0],'changed',ch.shape[0])
    # test: changed iff (no dom to the right AND not at edge) i.e. dom run continues rightward? compute
    pred=np.zeros_like(i,bool)
    for r in range(i.shape[0]):
        for c in range(i.shape[1]-1):
            if i[r,c]==dom and i[r,c+1]==dom: pred[r,c]=False
            elif i[r,c]==dom and i[r,c+1]!=dom: pred[r,c]=True
            else: pred[r,c]=False
    print('  rule "last dom run" match:', int((pred==ch).sum()), '/', ch.shape[0])

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
features=[]
for k in range(1,9):
    i=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {k} input']); o=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {k} output']); H,W=i.shape
    cnt=Counter(i.flatten()); dom=max(cnt,key=lambda v:cnt[v]); bg=dom
    fg_cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if i[r,c]!=bg]
    chg=[(r,c,int(i[r,c]),int(o[r,c])) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if o[r,c]!=i[r,c]]
    print(k,'bg',dom,'nfg',len(fg_cells),'changed',len(chg))
    for (r,c,fi,fo) in chg:
        # nearest fg by manhattan
        best=min(fg_cells,key=lambda p:max(abs(p[0]-r),abs(p[1]-c)))
        feats=(r,c,fi,fo,best, abs(best[0]-r)+abs(best[1]-c))
        features.append(feats)
print(features[:10])
# check: is fi always bg? and fo always fg? or fo==1?
print(set(tuple(x[:4]) for x in features))

import numpy as np, os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import numpy as np, os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
rows=[]
for k in range(1,9):
    i=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {k} input']); o=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {k} output']); H,W=i.shape
    dom=Counter(i.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for r in range(H):
        nz=[c for c in range(W) if i[r,c]!=dom]
        ch=int(o[r,c]==1) if any(i[r,c]!=o[r,c] for c in range(W)) else 0
        # features
        feat=(r, 
              (0 if not nz else min(nz)),   lead
              max(nz) if nz else -1,        lastfg
              (W-1-max(nz)) if nz else -1, tailbg
              sum(all(i[s,c]==dom for c in range(W)) for s in range(max(0,r-1,min(r+2,H)))) )
        rows.append((k,r,feat,'changed' if ch else 'unchanged'))
# print grouped by k
for g in [g for g in []]: pass
print(json.dumps(rows))

def solve(g):
    import numpy as np
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape
    cnts={int(v):int((g==v).sum()) for v in np.unique(g)}
    bg=max(cnts,key=lambda v:cnts[v])
    out=g.copy()
    # find maximal runs of consecutive rows containing any fg
    gr=[];grps=[];r=0
    while r<H:
        c=r
        while c<H and np.any(g[c]!=bg): c+=1
        if c>r: grp=list(range(r,c)); grps.append(grp); r=c
        else: break
        r=c
    # apply: in the FIRST band, for each row, fill from last fg cell+1 to edge with color 1
    fr=grps[0]
    for rr in fr:
        last=max(c for c in range(W) if g[rr,c]!=bg)
        if last<W-1:
            out[rr,last+1:] = 1
    return out.tolist()
